name: Bjørn Arnesen
bio:
Bjørn's career in motorsport began unconventionally. After serving in the Norwegian military police, specializing in high-security details, he transitioned his skills to the high-stakes world of racing. Initially providing security for a small rally team, his meticulous planning and proactive risk assessments quickly gained him recognition.

His approach to security is rooted in prevention rather than reaction. He meticulously analyzes potential threats, implementing layered security protocols that are both effective and unobtrusive. Bjørn believes in building trust and rapport with team members, fostering a culture of vigilance and shared responsibility. What sets him apart is his ability to seamlessly integrate cutting-edge security technology with traditional methods, creating a robust and adaptable security framework.

Bjørn's deep understanding of human behavior and his commitment to protecting both personnel and assets make him an invaluable asset to any motorsport team. He sees his role not just as a security provider, but as an integral part of the team's success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: A tall, imposing figure with a weathered face that reflects years of experience.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn pocketknife.
Insists on conducting a thorough security briefing before every race, regardless of team size.
Has a habit of silently observing people, assessing their behavior and potential risks.
